description: A sixteen row voltmeter. Each row reads out the voltage arriving at its input and passes that voltage on to the output on the same row

params.text: Clears the lowest and highest voltages held for every row
Switches the readings to the lowest and highest voltage each row has reached

inputs.text: A voltage to be read out on that row; a polyphonic cable here fills that row and the rows after it, one row per channel

outputs.text: Passes on the voltage arriving at the input on the same row

notes: a pulse at the reset input clears the lowest and highest voltages held for every row, doing what the reset button does
menu: Sort poly voltages — puts the channels of a polyphonic input in order before they are read out
Port 1 Out is POLY for all active values — turns the first output into a polyphonic output carrying the voltage of every row in use
Sort voltages ascending — sorts the voltages from lowest to highest rather than from highest to lowest
